title: Register a business name
what: Register the name the business trades under, unless it trades under its owner's own name.

sources.title: Business Names Registration Act 2011
sources.quote: An entity commits an offence if: (a) the entity carries on a business under a name; and (b) the name is not registered to the entity as a business name on the Business Names Register.

sources.title: Business Names Registration Act 2011
sources.quote: 24 Decision to register a business name to an entity (1) ASIC must register the business name to the entity if ASIC is satisfied that: (a) the entity has an ABN;

sources.title: Administrative Arrangements Order
sources.locator: Part 15 (Department of the Treasury), legislation administered by the Minister (compilation C2025Q00005 from 2025-07-01)
sources.quote: Business Names Registration Act 2011 Business Names Registration (Application of Consequential Amendments) Act 2011

reach.condition: if it trades under a name other than its owner's own name

sources.title: Business Names Registration Act 2011
sources.quote: Subsection (1) does not apply if: (a) the entity is an individual and the name is the individual’s name; or (b) the entity is a corporation and the name is the corporation’s name;

assessment.summary: A small online registration and fee for a business that trades under a name other than its owner's: no material effect on productivity or competition.
